CRUD = create, read, update, delete; map to use cases and persistence operations, often POST/GET/
PATCH/DELETE.
CRUD කියන්Jන් create, read, update, delete operations හතර. API methods ඒවට map කළතේ business
Create Read Update Delete · POST /items GET /items/1 PATCH /items/1 DELETE /items/1
Read the diagram: CRUD represents data lifecycle, not necessarily every possible business action.

POST /products     -> 201 Created
GET /products/42   -> 200 OK
PATCH /products/42 -> 200 OK
DELETE /products/42 -> 204 No Content
Expected result: The example maps common methods to resource operations.

Interview question: PUT vs PATCH?
Answer: PUT usually replaces the target representation; PATCH applies partial changes.
